body: Goal: Report a service problem with relevant facts and request a proportionate solution.

assignment.title: Four-skill practice, transfer and delayed return
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: answer “What should the customer do with the broken machine?” from the recording before reading the script. Save the listening result separately.

READ: answer the gist and detail questions, and mark the exact phrase that proves each answer. Save the reading result separately.

SPEAK: Explain a faulty product to customer service and negotiate a suitable solution. Record an independent first attempt, then improve one feature.

WRITE: Write a clear complaint about a damaged delivery. Draft without the model, then revise for reader, purpose, essential detail and next action.

TRANSFER: The seller offers only a discount; explain why that does or does not solve the problem.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: Reuse the fact–effect–request structure in a community proposal.
assignment.model:
SPEAKING MODEL: Jag köpte lampan den 3 maj. Paketet kom fram i går, men skärmen var sprucken. Jag har ordernumret och kan skicka ett foto. Jag önskar i första hand en ny lampa. Hur går vi vidare?

WRITING MODEL: Ämne: Reklamation, order 4821. Hej! Paketet levererades den 8 maj, men bordsskivan var skadad. Jag bifogar ett foto. Jag önskar en ny skiva eller återbetalning. Skicka gärna returinstruktioner. Vänliga hälsningar, Noor

takeaways: Use: Paketet kom fram, men innehållet var skadat.
Register: Den var sönder när den kom. → Varan var skadad vid leveransen.
A strong complaint makes it easy for the recipient to verify the case and take action.
